pages.text: You were never alone out here. The others keep close and look after themselves: they root for food, pick up what is worth having, and pull a branch from a tree when they feel unsafe.
When something goes for you, they go for it. When you go for something, so do they - so choose what you anger.$(br2)Hand them food, a weapon, anything. With empty hands, they hand you something back.

Call, and they call with you. One voice is a bluff; several is a reason to leave.$(br2)$(k:sneak) and $(k:use) on one to learn who they are. $(k:sneak) and $(k:attack) to wrestle - play fighting is how fighting is learned.

Feed a male and a female close together, and in a day there may be one more of you. Every kind of hominin lives in a band of its own size, and the land will only feed so many.$(br2)If you die, the band does not. Nor, quite, do you.
There are other bands. They will not follow you, but they carry things.$(br2)Hold out something of yours and offer it. If they have something worth as much, they will give it.

Press $(k:hominin_evolution.social) near your band to talk to them: to forage, to ask for food or a tool, or to say you are hurt. Near another band, ask them to walk with you for the day. Sneak-use one member first to talk to just them.
Stragglers find their way back to you.$(br2)Lose a whole band and some of what you learned is lost with it. Lose three, and your line ends.

$(l)Worth, to another band$()$(br)Everything falls into a tier. Trade for anything of the same tier or lower, never higher.$(br2)1 Common: food, sticks, rocks$(br)2 Useful: long branch, termite stick, quartzite$(br)3 Crafted: flake, Lomekwian core, chert$(br)4 Prized: chopper, spear

$(l)Treasured$()$(br)Top of the tiers, and hard to part with: $(#b87333)obsidian$(), a $(#b87333)chert hammerstone$(), an $(#b87333)Oldowan multi tool$().$(br2)Hold one out to another band and they will give you their best.$(br2)Ask your own band to fetch things too. They go and look for real.
